text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text describes responsibilities of an entity regarding Federal Council meetings and decisions, while German text describes managing parliamentary motions and does not mention Federal Council meetings or decisions.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "It plans the Federal Council meetings, draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council.", "before": ""}, "tgt": {"quote": "Sie verwaltet auch die jährlich rund 1300 parlamentarischen Vorstösse und organisiert deren Beantwortung.", "before": ""}, "severity": 1.0}, {"reason": "English text mentions \"Official Publications Centre (OPC)\" with specific responsibilities about the Federal Gazette and Classified Compilation, while German text uses \"Kompetenzzentrum Amtliche Veröffentlichungen (KAV)\" with slightly different wording and no mention of \"Classified Compilation\".", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The Official Publications Centre plays a key role in the Federal Administration, helping the federal offices to prepare texts for publication in the Federal Gazette or the Official Compilation, and keeping law texts in the Classified Compilation up to date.", "before": "Official Publications Centre (OPC)"}, "tgt": {"quote": "Das KAV unterstützt und berät die Bundesämter bei der Bearbeitung der Geschäfte welche im Bundesblatt oder in der Amtlichen Sammlung veröffentlicht werden müssen.", "before": "Kompetenzzentrum Amtliche Veröffentlichungen (KAV)"}, "severity": 0.6}]}
